a2-19-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Next Year
a2-19-01.scenario: At the café in Hanoi, Meg asks you about your plans for next year. You will travel and work.
a2-19-01.prompt: Tell Meg what you will do next year.
a2-19-01.target: Viajaré el próximo año. Trabajaré también.
a2-19-01.english: I will travel next year. I will work too.
a2-19-01.canDo: I can make simple statements about the future using regular futuro simple forms.

a2-19-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What Will You Do?
a2-19-02.scenario: At the language exchange in Hanoi, you ask Carlos about tomorrow and about where he will live next year.
a2-19-02.prompt: Ask Carlos what he will do tomorrow and where he will live next year.
cues: Ask what he will do tomorrow
Ask where he will live next year
a2-19-02.target: ¿Qué harás mañana? ¿Dónde vivirás el próximo año?
a2-19-02.english: What will you do tomorrow? Where will you live next year?
a2-19-02.canDo: I can ask and answer questions about future actions and plans.

a2-19-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Predictions
a2-19-03.scenario: At the café, Daniela wonders about the future of the language exchange in Hanoi. You give your prediction.
a2-19-03.prompt: Tell Daniela what you think will happen soon.
cues: Say it will probably happen soon
a2-19-03.target: Creo que cambiará mucho. Probablemente sucederá pronto.
a2-19-03.english: I think it will change a lot. It will probably happen soon.
a2-19-03.canDo: I can talk about predictions and expectations using the futuro simple.

a2-19-04.title: Communicative Challenge: My Goals
a2-19-04.scenario: At the café, Kaylee asks about your goals. You want to save money and to achieve your goals.
cues: Say you will achieve your goals
a2-19-04.target: Ahorraré dinero para viajar. Lograré mis objetivos.
a2-19-04.english: I will save money to travel. I will achieve my goals.
a2-19-04.canDo: I can talk about future plans, intentions and personal goals using the futuro simple.

a2-19-05.title: Communicative Challenge: New Paths
a2-19-05.scenario: After Lucía's farewell, the friends meet at their favourite café in Hanoi. Lauren asks what you will do now.
a2-19-05.prompt: Tell Lauren what you will do and say that you will always be friends.
cues: Say you will always be friends
a2-19-05.target: Viajaré por el sur de Vietnam. Siempre seremos amigos.
a2-19-05.english: I will travel through the south of Vietnam. We will always be friends.
a2-19-05.canDo: I can talk about what I and my friends will do in the future.

a2-19-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Plans and Predictions
a2-19-consolidation.scenario: At the café in Hanoi, Meg asks about your plans and what you think will happen.
a2-19-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg your plan for tomorrow and your prediction.
cues: Say what you will do tomorrow
a2-19-consolidation.english: I will work tomorrow. It will probably happen soon.
a2-19-consolidation.canDo: I can use the futuro simple to talk about plans, predictions and goals.
